name: open-publish-gateway
description: A Cloudflare Worker that lets Open Publish reach your R2 bucket without holding a storage key

BUCKET.description: The R2 bucket your notes are published to. Pick the bucket you already use, not a new one: a new bucket is empty, and your site would build from it with nothing in it.

TOKEN.description: A secret you invent. Paste the same value into Obsidian, in **Settings → Open Publish → Storage**. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`. It is the only credential the plugin holds, and you can change it here at any time.

PREFIX.description: Optional. Restricts this Worker to one folder of the bucket, so the token cannot reach anything else. Leave empty unless you already publish under a key prefix, in which case use the same value as `OP_PREFIX` in your site build.
